newsitem.title: USA: DeWolfe to create insurance subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: DeWolfe to create insurance subsidiary.

text.p: DeWolfe Cos Inc said on Wednesday it planned to create an insurance subsidiary to deliver personal insurance products and services to customers within its markets.
The company said the unit would be called DeWolfe Insurance Agency Inc and Thomas Jackson had been named president and chief operating officer.

"This new business unit is expected to improve future earnings and is an integral part of our plan to provide the benefits of 'one-stop' shopping to our customers," Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard DeWolfe said.
